_comment: Editorial and legal rules applied on every update and build. elections: election days (Europe/Sofia, YYYY-MM-DD); from 00:00 the day before until the end of the election day, poll stories and party channels are hidden (Изборен кодекс чл. 182(4), 205(5)). blocklist: stories (ids), items (urls), outlets (source ids), names (removed from every text) — for corrections and removal requests. corrections: the public log. replies: answers from candidates or parties (чл. 188 ИК) or anyone named, shown on the story.
